jobs.occupation: Join Freska as a Home Cleaner  Work Thursday and Friday!
jobs.description:
Join Freska as a Home Cleaner – Work only Thursday and Friday!
Do you have experience in home cleaning and want to work in a company that offers opportunities to grow and develop? Or are you at the beginning of your career and looking for high-quality training and a secure job? We are now looking for home cleaners who are available to work Thursday and Friday 8-17 – apply today!
Freska – More than just a cleaning company 💙
Freska is one of the fastest-growing companies with a clear goal: to be the best and most recommended workplace for service workers in Europe. Our values—People First, Growth, and Responsibility—guide everything we do to create a great work environment.
We offer our employees:
✅ A stable job with part-time contract (Thursday–Friday 8-17)﻿
✅ A collective agreement and health benefits
✅ Paid travel time between customers
✅ Career development and training in home cleaning
✅ A supportive team with a dedicated team leader
✅ Immediate office support during your workday
✅ Unlimited coffee and friendly chats in the office
✅ Overtime compensated at 228 kr/ hour, with monthly payouts and no time bank!
About the job
As a home cleaner, you will take care of our customers’ homes by performing tasks such as dusting, vacuuming, and mopping. Attention to detail is a great advantage in this role. You will use the Freska Pro app to access your schedule, customer details, and important company information.
Who we are looking for
🔹 Speaks Swedish or English
🔹 Can work Thursday and Friday between 08:00–17:00
🔹 Has a valid work permit
🔹 A driving license and access to a car are a plus but not required
🔹 Experience in cleaning is beneficial but not a requirement
👉 Apply now and become part of the Freska family!

jobs.occupation: Vi söker budbilsförare med manuelt B-körkort
jobs.description:
Hera Transport AB söker engagerade förare med B-körkort! 🚐

Vill du bli en del av ett växande transportföretag där service, kvalitet och punktlighet står i fokus? Vi söker nu ansvarsfulla och drivna förare som vill arbeta kvällstid.

📍 Arbetsplats: Utgångspunkter från Uppsala och Farsta

🕒 Arbetstid: 16:00 – 23:00
📦 Meriterande erfarenhet:

✅️Tidigare arbete med Airmee

Vi erbjuder dig:

✅️En trevlig arbetsmiljö med ett stöttande team

✅️Möjlighet att växa inom företaget

✅️Arbete i ett företag som värdesätter kvalitet och kundnöjdhet

Vi söker dig som:

✅️Har B-körkort manuelt

✅️Är punktlig, noggrann och serviceinriktad

✅️Har god lokalkännedom i Stockholm med omnejd

✅️Kan arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar

Ansökan:
Skicka din ansökan till jobb@heratransport.se
Märk gärna mejlet med “Jobbansökan Förare”.
Uppsala
Farsta
---

English – Job Advertisement

Hera Transport AB is hiring dedicated drivers with a B driving license! 🚐

Do you want to be part of a growing transport company where service, quality, and reliability are top priorities? We are now looking for responsible and motivated drivers to join our evening shifts.

📍 Starting locations: Uppsala and Farsta 

🕒 Working hours: 16:10 – 23:00
📦 Preferred experience:

✅️Previous work with Airmee

✅️Previous work with Budbee

We offer you:

✅️A supportive and friendly work environment

✅️Opportunities for growth within the company

✅️A workplace where quality and customer satisfaction are key values

We are looking for someone who:

✅️Holds a B driving license manual

✅️Is punctual, detail-oriented, and service-minded

✅️Has good knowledge of Stockholm and surrounding areas

✅️Can work independently and take responsibility

Application:
Send your application to jobb@heratransport.se
Please mark your email with “Driver Job Application”.
Farsta
Uppsala
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

jobs.occupation: BEST Integration Manager for Colas Rail Sweden Filial
jobs.description:
The BEST Integration Manager acts as the central point of contact for all design-related interfaces, ensuring that various design packages (e.g., civil, structural, signalling, electrification, catenary, telecommunication, etc…) are compatible, buildable, and delivered according to the project schedule. 
They proactively identify potential conflicts between design disciplines and external stakeholders, implementing solutions to prevent delays.
Key Job Accountabilities:
•            Interface Register/Matrix: identify, document, and manage all internal and external interface points via a comprehensive Interface Register and Matrix.
•            Interface Management Plan: develop, implement, and maintain the Project Interface Management Plan, procedures, and protocols.
•            Interface Planning: Ensure that both interface contributors (Leader and Follower) have a shared planning for interface development (Preliminary, Pre-final, final) according to overall Design Planning.
•            Design Coordination: lead coordination meetings to resolve technical issues between different design teams and subcontractors, ensuring design compatibility.
•            Stakeholder Communication: act as the liaison between the client, designers, contractors, and third parties to manage expectations and ensure timely information exchange.
•            Risk Mitigation: identify potential technical and commercial risks arising from interface issues and develop mitigation plans.
•            Close-out: audit and formally close out all design interfaces upon completion.
Qualifications / experience required:
•            Education: Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical or Systems Engineering.
•            Experience: Proven experience in interface management or project engineering, within rail industry (10+ years commonly required for senior roles).
•            Technical Knowledge: Understanding of railway systems (signalling, electrification, catenary, telecommunication) and construction processes.
•            Experience in multidisciplinary project environments and working with international stakeholders.
•            Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
•            Strong problem-solving ability and experience in risk and change management.
•            Proficiency in project management tools and MS Office Suite.
•            Languages: fluent in English. French and Swedish knowledge is considered a plus.
